scope: 67 registered standard-risk engines in bounded16/10/10/11/10/10 batches; no master-catalog approval.
expectedValuePolicy: Literal independent arithmetic, never spec.compute/calculate-generated. Compare finite values within16 binary64 epsilons relative error, exact mathematical zero; no financial rounding policy.

algebra.contract: Declared arithmetic identities and field constraints in launch-portfolio.ts
algebra.verification: Textbook reference not re-fetched in this run; arithmetic derivations explicit, external-source approval remains outstanding.

geometry.verification: Existing Work reference reused for geometry context; exact area/perimeter source provenance still requires reviewer evidence, no identity approval inferred.

mechanics.contract: Declared distance/time, work/time, Ohm, period/wave, data/flow-rate and impulse identities with compatible input units.
mechanics.verification: Reference not re-fetched; only elementary stated-model arithmetic asserted, not a safety/engineering approval.

ecmascript.contract: Existing truncating remainder and Math.round semantics
ecmascript.verification: Named ECMAScript semantics retained; not a financial rounding policy.
